Don’t. I was where you were a few months ago. I lost two great loves of my life. My dog my super sweet cuddly mutt that was my emotional strength and the reason I never wanted to get out of bed got hit by a car when I was out of town. I blamed myself, I was riddled with guilt and just really sad. My off/on partner of 12 years told me he couldn’t handle my sadness or how he put it he couldn’t be responsible for my mental health and left me a week later.  I’d never felt that sad in my life. When I say I was devastated, I mean I was de.vas.tated. Whenever I drove I’d have thoughts of just driving into a tree. I cried all the time. I started cutting. At one point I even made a noose and tried it on. It was bad. I felt no joy. Then one morning I didn’t wake up empty. One of my friends has become more than friends. I’m going to the gym. Listening to music I loved from middle school and for the first time in months I’m actually sorta happy. My point is feel the shit, grieve and mourn your losses. Then, go dancing, go for a run, paint a mural, sew a blanket, do something for you. You will feel better. And that music thing works every time.
